synthesizedFacts.fact: The skin barrier, also known as the moisture barrier, is crucial for protecting against external aggressors and preventing moisture loss.
Common ingredients for repairing the skin barrier include ceramides, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, probiotics, oat beta-glucan, and glycerin.
A compromised skin barrier can lead to symptoms such as dryness, irritation, redness, and increased sensitivity.
Environmental factors like cold weather, low humidity, and hot showers can exacerbate skin barrier damage.
